note: Knowledge chunks for the ingestion scan and the answer check (N-038). The tenant's official channels are official_domains and official_contacts. Development groups (rules are tuned against these): found (the red team's wordings and the planted demo injection), benign (ordinary policy text sharing words with attacks), links and benign_links (outside links, written by the rule author before the link rule), review_attacks and review_benign (written by a second model reviewing the rules, 2026-10-20). Held out: held_out (written before the first rule change, never used to tune) and evals/blind_heldout.json (written by a separate model that never saw the code, the rules or these cases; measured, never read for tuning). To measure a new idea, write new cases.
